chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far Abu al-Husayn al-Asadi narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Barmaki narrated to us, he said: Ja'far ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tamimi narrated to us, from his father, he said: Abdul Malik ibn Umair al-Shaybani narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family and grant them peace) said:

"I am the master of the prophets and the messengers, and superior to the close angels. My successors are the masters of the successors of the prophets and the messengers, and my progeny are the best of the progenies of the prophets and the messengers, and my companions who followed my path are the best companions of the prophets and the messengers, and my daughter Fatima is the lady of the women of the worlds, and the pure ones among my wives are the mothers of the believers.

And my nation is the best nation brought forth for the people, and I am the prophet with the most followers on the Day of Resurrection. And I have a pool whose width is the distance between Busra and Sana'a, containing pitchers as numerous as the stars of the sky. And my successor at the pool on that day is my successor in this world."

It was asked: "And who is that, O Messenger of God?" He said: "The leader of the Muslims, the commander of the faithful, and their guardian after me: Ali ibn Abi Talib. He will give drink from it to his friends and drive away his enemies from it, just as one of you drives away a strange camel from the water."

Then he (may God bless him and his family and grant them peace) said: "Whoever loves Ali and obeys him in this world will come to my pool tomorrow and will be with me at my level in Paradise. And whoever hates Ali in this world and disobeys him, I will not see him nor will he see me on the Day of Resurrection, and he will be snatched away from me and taken to the left, toward the Fire."

key_terms.أوصياء: Successors/executors of wills -- those appointed by prophets to continue their mission
key_terms.حوض: The Pool (Hawd) -- a heavenly reservoir promised to the Prophet Muhammad at the Day of Judgment from which the faithful will drink
key_terms.خليفة: Successor/caliph -- one who takes the place of another in authority; here used to designate Ali as the Prophet's rightful successor
key_terms.سيد: Master/chief -- the highest rank among a group

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Pool (Hawd) on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated by Ibn Abbas, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) enumerates his unique distinctions among all prophets -- including his superiority over the angels, the excellence of his successors, progeny, companions, and daughter Fatima (AS). He describes the Pool (Hawd) that awaits him on the Day of Judgment and reveals that its custodian is his successor in this world. When asked who that successor is, the Prophet explicitly names Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) as the leader of the Muslims, commander of the faithful, and guardian after him. The hadith concludes with a stark warning: those who love and obey Ali will drink from the Pool and join the Prophet in Paradise, while those who hate and disobey Ali will be denied the Prophet's intercession and cast into Hell.
word_analysis: and he will be snatched away
